'''Woostri''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] known for its [[Woostri HoloScan Database|HoloScan Database]], tourism, and automated manufacturing.

==Description==
[[File:Woostri.jpg|thumb|left|Woostri]]
Woostri was almost entirely covered by [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] [[Water/Legends|waters]], which submerged a massive continent that once covered the planet. What little land remained above water was dominated by the [[Woostoid]]s' vast automated cities and popular white-sand beaches. Some historians concluded that a major disaster occurred on the planet that caused this land to have sunk into the planet's fragile crust.

The planet's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] supported organic based life. The plant life of Woostri did not turn out an abundance of [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]], causing many on the planet to believe it had a thin atmosphere when, in actuality, there was a shortage of oxygen that their bodies were striving to supply them with.

In the [[Old Republic era]], Woostri's array of databases was second only to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] in size. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space. The Woostoids supported the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] due to their affinity for order. Woostri eventually joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], but was captured by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] prior to his attack on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Thrawn's [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Death's Head]]'' led the [[Battle of Woostri|assault]].
{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Woostri in the [[Sumitra sector/Legends|Sumitra sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].
